scope: Ten-fold sampled conditional-DNA DeepLIFT and saturation mutagenesis: 2000 held-out genes/DNA groups, 50 original A/FiLM checkpoints, no training or ChIP alteration. Not all 15351 genes or independent biological validation.
DeepLIFT: custom DeepLIFT Rescale with explicit GroupNorm square/rsqrt Rescale and symmetric product rule; fixed actual FiLM regulation
instance_selection: Original SHA256 ordering, not Y, model effect, direction or visual appeal
highlight_selection: Original minimum PWM score change, not maximum prediction effect
delta: mutant minus WT original-scale signed pooled Y_PC1
motif_rescan: Same target only, not all-library specificity audit
figures: PDF only; user-authorized 10x4.8 inches; ticks 12, axes 14, legend 12, embedded TrueType
statistics: Descriptive per-instance r/rho over motif-internal substitutions; dependent SNPs, no independent-replicate or prediction-accuracy claim
no_evaluable_instance: Explicit absent/not_evaluable record; not zero biological effect

prediction_alignment.FP32: Original full forward versus conditional wrapper, unchanged forward atol/rtol 2e-5
prediction_alignment.saved_predictions: Separate original CUDA BF16 batch64 inverse-target reproduction, same diagnostic atol2e-4 rtol2e-5
prediction_alignment.cross_precision_difference: Recorded, not treated as same-precision alignment failure
prediction_alignment.scientific_inference: Original FP32 remains unchanged; BF16 used for historical-prediction QC only
